title: jacobaea morrisonensis
intro: Jacobaea morrisonensis, commonly known as Hawaiian ragwort, is a flowering plant species native to the Hawaiian Islands. It has been traditionally used in Hawaiian medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can be used to treat wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Jacobaea morrisonensis include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reduce inflammation, and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being studied, but it is known to contain sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
